findings.description: The Lambda function hard-codes AWS access_key and secret_key values directly in the environment variables block. These long-lived static credentials are stored in the function configuration and Terraform state in cleartext, where anyone with read access to the Lambda config, console, or state file can retrieve them and use them to authenticate to AWS.

The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches from AWS. Running an unmaintained runtime exposes the function to known unpatched vulnerabilities in the language runtime and its dependencies.
